data.case_name: State of Ohio v. Marcus Williamson
data.court: Franklin County Court of Common Pleas
claims: Nine robbery counts; five second-degree felonies and four third-degree felonies.
data.outcome: Guilty pleas on nine robbery counts. Current reporting says no immediate prison and approximately 21.5 years held in reserve; exact judgment entry remains to be captured.
